original_context: Zaniyah does not conform to society.
If someone respects authority and seeks conformity, then they obey rules.
For Zaniyah, being independent and conforming to society are mutually exclusive.
Zaniyah is either open-minded or seeks conformity, but not both.
If Zaniyah is independent, then she is either open-minded or follows tradition, but not both.
Zaniyah either thinks critically or follows tradition, but not both.
If Zaniyah values freedom, then she thinks critically and embraces existentialism.
For all humans, if they embracing existentialism, then they create their own meaning in life.
conclusion: Zaniyah creates her own meaning in life.

openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake: The problematic pair is: FOL: p_8(Zaniyah) ⊕ p_1(Zaniyah)  NL: “For Zaniyah, being independent and conforming to society are mutually exclusive.” The FOL uses exclusive-or (⊕), which asserts that exactly one of p_8(Zaniyah) or p_1(Zaniyah) is true. The NL phrase “mutually exclusive” only states they cannot both be true (¬(p_8 ∧ p_1)) and does not by itself claim that one of them must hold. So the FOL is stronger than the NL. A closer formalization of the NL would be ¬(p_8(Zaniyah) ∧ p_1(Zaniyah)) rather than p_8(Zaniyah) ⊕ p_1(Zaniyah).
